answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch and commit to an identity polynomial, proving membership in a Semaphore tree without disclosing their identity. RLN derives a rate-limit nullifier and Shamir share from each epoch evaluation; a duplicate message under the same quota yields inconsistent shares that reconstruct the private key. A verifier can then submit proof of exposure for immediate collateral slashing, making Sybil identities costly. The tide of messages may reach the harbor, but duplicate use leaves a delta of evidence.
